notes: Section 7, 1935 edition, 5400x4231 (the same section is scanned again, lower half only, as p15). 1-bit photocopy. Frame on all four sides: thick speckled bar, white gap, thin inner rule (innermost, ~4 px); corner arcs (thick + thin) in all four corners, each thin arc joined to the side rules by a short connector (a ~6-10 px joggle). Rule 1: the outline lies ~1.5-2 px inside the thin rule's inner edge, fitted locally (+-80 px) so it follows the rule's bows, points <= 150 px apart; the 1-bit rule edge is ragged, so single px of the rule's edge touch the outline in places. Rule 2: the outline follows the thin arc's inner edge (~2 px inside, points <= 30 px apart) and steps round each connector on its map side, so arcs, connectors and everything beyond them are outside. The page is turned ~0.3 deg: thin rule's inner edge top y 393 (x 500) -> 416 (x 4810), bottom 3970 -> 4017, right x 5031 (y 640) -> 5004 (y 3790); the left rule bows (x 286 at y 626, 292 at y 1990, 287 at y 3300). Arc radii TL ~213, TR ~215, BL ~216, BR ~205. Connector steps at TL x 501 / y 609, TR x 4813 / y 639, BR y 3808 / x 4784, BL x 502 / y 3753. Kind b (map ink truly touches the rule; the outline follows the rule's inner edge through it, the edge there taken as the rule's clean outer edge + its thickness): 141 of the outline's 325 stretches hold ink. Left side: solid commercial blocks are fused to the rule at y ~2080-2130, ~2330-2380, ~2780-3130 and ~3480-3630, and street lines run into it all the way down (one right under the TL connector, y ~608). Top: block lines lie along the rule (1 px inside it or fused) at x ~1570-1680 and ~2525-2600, street lines meet it elsewhere; a street line starts at the end of the TL arc (x ~500). Bottom: a solid block at x ~1300-1350, lot lines elsewhere. Right: clean (bay). Doubt: a pasted grey (stippled) patch covers the bottom rule at x ~2934-3076 (its top edge y ~3984-3987); no rule is visible there, so the outline runs straight across it from the rule either side (2920,3984.2 -> 3090,3987.4), not round the patch. 'Join Sec. 6 / 2 / 8 / 12' print outside the frame. Remove (rule 4): remove[0] the rotated CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP / PREPARED BY / CITY PLANNING COMMISSION / 1935 / R.S. WOODWARD title, LEGEND with its six swatches and labels, and the scale bar with its (broken) SCALE lettering (top right; no ruled box; ink x 4360-5011, y 547-1217). Map ink presses on it from the top-left, left and bottom-left, so the outline (18 points) threads the paper gaps instead of being a box: 3 px above the swatches (y 544, under two street-line ends at y ~540); stepped down to y 600 right of the swatches; on the right between the CITY & COUNTY line and the right rule (6 px from the text); along the bottom at y 1187, stepped down to y 1223 round the end of LIGHT INDUSTRIAL DIST. (the block number just below it, y >= 1229, stays map) and at y 1203 under the two ditto marks (the TER. street name and its line, 7 px away, stay map); on the left along the scale bar with a bulge round SCALE, stepped in above the bar. No ink under it. remove[1] the compass rose (ink x 4532-4750, y 3704-3964), turned ~95 deg, with its tail and feather, the true-north needle (tip ~4969,3861) and the magnetic needle with its flag (tip ~4927,3945); 23 points. The rose and both needle heads lie on blank paper in the bay corner, 15-20 px inside the BR arc. THE TAIL FEATHER IS PRINTED OVER MAP INK: the feather (x 4254-4318, y 3789-3815) lies across the pointed tip of a hatched light-industrial block, the corner of the gridded block below it and the street lines between them, and the shaft leaves that tip at ~4330,3807. The polygon still takes the whole tail (README rule 4) as a strip ~25-35 px wide round the feather, so its edges there cross block ink: that is the only ink under a remove outline on this sheet (ink check 23 / 16 / 15 / 8 / 7 on those stretches, 0 elsewhere), and the slivers of block tip inside the strip are removed with the feather. Doubt: three short strokes just below the feather's right end (x 4302-4322, y 3816-3827) read as the broken tip of the block outline, not as fletching; the strip's lower edge (y 3819) cuts through them. Paper specks beside the needle head (4953-4962, 3845-3871) are inside, one at 4977-4979,3844-3848 outside. remove[2] the SECTION 7 badge (ring centre 4898,3616, radius 57), an octagon 5 px outside the ring, on blank paper. Not removed: street names and block numbers.
drawn_by: Claude (LB training labels, issue #71), on full-resolution crops and ASCII dumps of the scan only, 2026-11-21: side rules measured on every 2nd px (the thin rule's clean outer edge + its own thickness wherever map ink is fused to it), corner arcs traced along the thin arc's inner edge, connector steps and remove polygons placed from pixel dumps; every vertex checked close up; ink check run
